scope: Two hydraulically isolated finite-inventory Euler circuits, typed channel/chamber wall ports, caloric walls and transactional online external heat control

method.stability: per-stage acoustic and summed thermal conductance bounds

control.revision: checked under per-instance reentrant lock through commit
control.history: bounded unique command IDs and checkpointed receipts
control.concurrency: in-process serialized object calls; no distributed transactions

limitations: restricted two-circuit topology, no arbitrary hydraulic branching/plenum/nozzle
no PID/AI or hybrid-event orchestration embedded in the assembly
no public SDK integration or target-fluid/phase/plant calibration
no all-state entropy-stability or cross-platform exact replay proof
no full repository regression; portable environment inherits scientific dependencies
